Udacity ML DevOps project.

Turning a churn notebook into maintainable code

A customer-churn analysis refactored into reusable functions, logging and tests.

Python · pandas · scikit-learn · Matplotlib · Logging · Testing

The question

An exploratory notebook is difficult to maintain as a repeatable workflow.

The work

  • Separate ingestion, exploratory analysis, feature preparation and training.
  • Compare logistic regression and random forest using ROC curves.
  • Add a script for logging and function tests.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Repository includes churn_library.py, a logging/test script and saved analytical outputs.

What I learned

  • Software structure, testability and diagnostics are part of delivering ML.

Project context

  • Course dataset and historical model outputs; no commercial churn impact claimed.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
